result.brief: 提出 OmniUE，用可学习 token 的中间层表征构建文本-视频-音频统一嵌入空间，并支持文本、视觉区域、音频片段的多模态交互式查询，生成用户条件的 any-to-any 嵌入。
result.reason: Learns a unified text-video-audio embedding space with user-conditioned any-to-any embeddings, a multimodal representation contribution directly relevant to video/multimodal representation learning.
